changeinfo.changes: • Fixed an issue where some items from the Ultimate Vault Hunter Upgrade Pack are not persisting after saving or cross-saving.

• Fixed various bugs.
  • Improved overall playability.
  • Added option for additional vehicle control method.
  • Added sort by value option for inventory.
  • Added user's support ID in the SHiFT menu.
  • Increased drop rate of legendary items across the game.
  • Updated PS Vita SDK to 3.500.
  • Enabled +77 MB expanded memory mode.
  • Enabled PlayStation TV support.

• Fixed crash that would occur for players with 32 or more friends on "PSN"
  • Adding cross-save support with PlayStation®4 system Borderlands: The Handsome Collection
  • Minor fixes
